data.name: Hidden Horizons: Christmas Tour Collector's Edition
data.detailed_description:
Step into a festive island getaway touched by a gentle holiday storyline, just enough to set the mood without getting in the way. The heart of the experience lies in exploring beautifully crafted scenes filled with varied challenges, seasonal puzzles, and delightful hidden object searches designed to keep your attention sharp from stop to stop.

Journey across radiant Christmas islands where ocean breezes mingle with holiday lights. Join the Hill family as they celebrate a sun-kissed Christmas in the Canary Islands, an adventure that feels like flipping through a living postcard. Wander the tinsel-trimmed hotel halls and dive into the lively Santa Cruz parade with Dustin; search yacht decks and the Los Cristianos pier with Melody; browse sparkling markets in Las Palmas and artisanal stalls in San Cristobal with Greg; and take in volcanic wonders at Cueva del Viento and sweeping Gran Canaria vistas with Daisy. Add even more color to your tour with trips to Lanzarote’s vineyards, Guimar’s mysterious pyramids, and lush botanical gardens. Find hidden objects, collect keepsakes, and enjoy warm and cozy seasonal mini-games: from clever matching tasks to festive hands-on riddles, all wrapped in the glow of holiday spirit.

Embark on a vibrant selection of puzzles and mini-games: every location offers a fresh challenge that rewards curiosity, attention, and playful thinking.

Featuring:

🔎 Dozens of unique puzzles, brainteasers, and mini-games

🔎 Snow-kissed scenes sprinkled with subtle story details waiting to be discovered

🔎 Cozy, tradition-inspired mini-challenges that bring the festive fairs to life

🔎 Exclusive seasonal secrets, wallpapers, and extra content to unlock

🔎 Collect joyful souvenirs along the way

🔎 A wide range of achievements to celebrate your progress

🔎 A magnifying glass to help you comb through each scene without missing a single find

Pack your holiday spirit and set off on a bright, relaxing Christmas escape, where every scene brings a new discovery and every moment shines a little warmer!
